document.title: Operator Health Check — 2026-03-11 16:51 UTC
document.content:
# Operator Health Check

## Summary
- Overall state: degraded
- PM2: 12 online, 1 stopped
- Docker: multiple application containers running, but 3 unhealthy/degraded states detected
- Disk: / at 69% used
- RAM: 11093 MiB used / 27532 MiB total (~40%)
- GPU: RTX 4090 present, 20550 MiB / 24564 MiB in use by VLLM::EngineCore, 0% util at sample time
- OpenClaw gateway: RPC reachable on 127.0.0.1:18789, but user systemd service reports inactive/dead and service config is flagged as out of date/non-standard

## PM2
Online:
- agent-log
- gpu-router
- iam-chat-proxy
- kira-admin
- kira-app
- kira-dashboard
- oopuo-website
- openclaw-bridge
- openclaw-gateway
- stella-tax
- whatsapp-bridge
- zenithcred-website

Problem:
- whisper: stopped

## Docker concerns
- langfuse_langfuse-web_1: restarting
- lidaros-frontend-1: unhealthy
- omiximo-email-automation: unhealthy

## Docker healthy/running sample
- neo4j-server: up
- iam-ghost / iam-nginx / iam-mysql: up (mysql healthy)
- inventree stack: backend/db/redis healthy, frontend up
- omiximo-bridge: healthy
- ollama: up
- n8n: up
- evolution_api: up

## Resource checks
- Disk pressure is acceptable; no filesystem above alert threshold
- Memory pressure is acceptable; no swap configured
- GPU memory use is high but below alert threshold and appears assigned to active inference service

## OpenClaw notes
- Listening on 127.0.0.1:18789
- RPC probe succeeded
- systemd user service state: inactive/dead, last exit 203
- Service file embeds token and is recommended for reinstall/cleanup by CLI diagnostics
- Doctor warnings also note empty group allowlists for WhatsApp/Telegram group policies; this is configuration drift, not an immediate outage

## Recommended next actions
1. Check why whisper is stopped and whether it is expected
2. Inspect logs for langfuse web restart loop
3. Inspect healthcheck failures for lidaros-frontend-1 and omiximo-email-automation
4. Decide whether OpenClaw should be managed by PM2 only or by systemd; remove or reinstall stale user service accordingly
